 L-R: Jared Padalecki as Jack in 'Guarding Stars,' Maddie Ziegler as Mae in 'In a Holidaze' and Arnold Schwarzenegger as Santa in 'The Man With The Bag' 
 Netflix/Prime Video 
 As 2026 comes to a close, it’s time to grab blankets and hot chocolate for the string of holiday films headed to streaming and in theaters.
 Starting in November, various book adaptations and Christmas flicks will be arriving on streamers like Hulu, Netflix and Prime Video starring the likes of Lucy Hale, Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki, Christopher Briney and Michelle Randolph, Maddie Ziegler, Rob Lowe, Arnold Schwarzenegger and more.
 RELATED: ‘Ebenezer’ Review: Johnny Depp Blissfully Goes All Scrooge In Ti West’s New Horror-Flavored Take On Dickens Christmas Classic 
 Also heading to theaters mid-November is Ti West’s Ebenezer , which stars Johnny Depp as the titular Mr. Scrooge, a Christmas curmudgeon whose story always reminds viewers how to get into the holiday spirit.
 ‘The 12 Dates of Christmas’ – Hulu – Nov. 6
 Pretty Little Liars stars Lucy Hale and Ian Harding reunited in the Hulu and Disney+ Christmas film, The 12 Dates of Christmas , which arrived to streaming Nov. 6, 2026. Christina Walker (Hale) is challenged by her friend to go on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas because she made a promise to her mother that she would never be single on Christmas Eve ever again. After a string of bad luck meeting up with livestreamer men and criminals, she might just fall for Harding’s character.
 ‘Ebenezer’ – Theaters – Nov. 13
 Image Credit: Paramount Pictures 
 A new take on Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol starring Johnny Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge will arrive in theatres Friday, Nov. 13. The film is directed by Ti West, and it also stars Ian McKellen as Jacob Marley, Sam Claflin as Fred, Arthur Conti as a young Ebenezer, Rupert Grint as Bob Cratchit, Tramell Tillman as the Ghost of Christmas Present, Andrea Riseborough as the Ghost of Christmas Past, Ellie Bamber as Belle, Daisy Ridley and more.
 RELATED: Actors Who Have Portrayed & Voiced Ebenezer Scrooge: Alastair Sim To Jim Carrey 
 ‘Guarding Stars’ – Netflix – Nov. 18
 Image Credit: Chris Large/Netflix 
 ‘Clashing Through The Snow’ – Prime Video – Nov. 23
 Image Credit: Prime Video 
 Christopher Briney ( The Summer I Turned Pretty ) and Michelle Randolph ( 1923, Landman ) star in Prime Video’s upcoming Clashing Through the Snow , directed by Carson Young from a script written by Danney Mackey and Rebecca Ewing. The romantic comedy watches a pair of high-up editors at a publishing company compete for their similar role, which is threatened by layoffs, by booking big meetings in New York over the Christmas holiday. Despite their dislike of each other, the universe brings them together on their chaotic journey across the country, making room for romance to develop.
 RELATED: It’s Christopher Briney Vs. Michelle Randolph In Prime Video’s ‘Clashing Through The Snow’ Trailer Featuring Olivia Rodrigo’s Christmas Single 
 ‘The Man With The Bag’ – Prime Video – Dec. 2
 Image Credit: Prime Video 
 Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as Santa Claus in Amazon MGM Studios’ The Man With The Bag 30 years after he starred in Jingle All The Way . Schwarzenegger’s latest action flick also stars Alan Ritchson as the thief enlisted to help recover Santa’s magic sack in which he stores all of his Christmas Eve deliveries, which are stolen by a naughty elf. The cast also includes Berkeley James, Michael Cyril Creighton, Liza Koshy, Kyle Mooney, Jane Krakowski, with Ken Jeong and Awkwafina, whose casting Deadline first reported .
 RELATED: ‘The Man With The Bag’ Trailer: Arnold Schwarzenegger & Alan Ritchson Star In Amazon MGM’s Christmas Heist Caper 
 ‘In a Holidaze’ – Netflix – Dec. 2
 Image Credit: Bettina Strauss/Netflix 
 Another book adaptation headed to Netflix this December is In a Holidaze by Christina Lauren. The film stars Maddie Ziegler , Rob Lowe , Graham Phillips and Elias Kacavas, and it is billed as Love Actualy meets Groundhog Day . Patton Oswalt, Jackie Sandler, Gil Bellows and Andrea Anders will also appear . The script was adapted by Tiffany Paulsen , who also directs.
 ‘Violent Night 2’ – Theaters – Dec. 4
 Image Credit: Universal Pictures 
 David Harbour is back as a down and dirty Santa Claus in Violent Night 2 , coming to theaters Dec. 4 from 87North and Universal. Tommy Wirkola is back in the director’s chair, and Pat Casey and Josh Miler wrote the sequel’s script after penning that for the original. Kristen Bell has joined the film as Mrs. Claus, and Daniela Melchior, Jared Harris, Joe Pantoliano, Maxwell Friedman and Andrew ‘King Bach’ Bachelor will also appear.
